name: ltm-wiki
description: Automatically provision and maintain project-scoped, source-backed LLM Wikis inside an Obsidian Vault.

interface.longDescription: Install once and let Codex resolve or create a separate source-backed LLM Wiki for each project inside your chosen Obsidian Vault. Existing project knowledge is reused without introducing MCP, a database, embeddings, or ambient conversation memory.
defaultPrompt: Use $llm-wiki to resolve this project's Wiki and continue my task.
Use $llm-wiki to add this document to the project Wiki.
Use $llm-wiki to check the project Wiki for conflicts.
